verdict.rationale: Simular's own docs show multi-item execution: up to 5 cloud computers can run tasks at the same time, and workflows saved as code can be replayed repeatedly or on a schedule. Together these give a plausible but indirect route to processing many items. No evidence describes a first-class bulk operation that applies one action across a batch of items. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or batch operation over many items, item-level batch semantics (lists, CSVs, records), per-item status or error handling in batch runs, and hands-on corroboration of batch processing at scale.
